title.narrative: [PHASE 2] Elimination of worst forms of child labour in the Mica mining belt in Jharkhand, India

description.narrative: The project intends to eliminate child labour from the  Mica supply chain in the Jharkhand state of India. It will continue the comprehensive approach to remove from exploitative situations, empower children and their families to enhance their quality of life.The project implementation will be implemented by Jago Foundation with support from TdH-NL.
